answer: Reputation decays exponentially with a fixed half-life, requiring sustained, verified honest service across a meaningful time horizon to retain influence. In the reciprocity-weighted EigenTrust matrix, a freshly spawned sybil has near-zero eigenvector centrality without trusted incoming paths; self-ratings and collusive links carry little weight, leaving it unable to meet consensus thresholds. A gale of new accounts cannot turn shale-thin trust into durable influence.
